WITH frpm_calc AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."School Name",
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
    f."Low Grade" AS low_grade,
    f."High Grade" AS high_grade,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS free_meal_rate
  FROM frpm f
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
county_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(free_meal_rate) AS avg_rate FROM frpm_calc
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT * FROM frpm_calc ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t."School Name",
  t.charter,
  t.low_grade,
  t.high_grade,
  CASE
    WHEN s.NumTstTakr IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS sat_performance,
  t.free_meal_rate - c.avg_rate AS deviation_from_county_avg
FROM top_school t
CROSS JOIN county_avg c
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = SUBSTR(t.CDSCode, 1, 7) || '0000000'	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Street AS street,
    s.City AS city,
    s.Zip AS zip,
    s.OpenDate AS open_date,
    CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS status,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_rate,
    sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
    sa.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,
    sa.AvgScrMath AS avg_math,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write,
    sa.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500,
    CASE
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 'High FRPM'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 0.50 THEN 'Medium FRPM'
      ELSE 'Low FRPM'
    END AS frpm_level
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
    AND s.Charter = 1
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  street,
  city,
  zip,
  open_date,
  status,
  enrollment_k12,
  frpm_count_k12,
  frpm_rate,
  num_test_takers,
  avg_read,
  avg_math,
  avg_write,
  num_ge1500,
  frpm_level,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC) AS frpm_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH perf AS (
  SELECT s.School AS school_name,
         s.City AS city,
         s.Magnet AS magnet,
         sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
         sa.AvgScrRead AS avg_read,

           ELSE 'Very High'

           WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 THEN 'Excellent'
           WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 1200 THEN 'Good'
           WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 900 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Below Average'
         END AS performance_category
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Magnet = 1
    AND sa.NumTstTakr > 500
)
SELECT school_name,
       city,
       num_test_takers,
       avg_read,
       avg_math,
       avg_write,
       total_avg_sat,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC) AS sat_rank,
       frpm_pct,
       poverty_level,
       performance_category
FROM perf
ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools
